document.name: Time-Limited Demand
document.definition: The firm's letter offering to settle John Doe's BI claim for Keystone's **$10,000 per-person limit**, open for a fixed time.
document.purpose: Makes Keystone **decide on the record**: the limit, a Limited Release of Smith and Keystone only, Smith's affidavit of no other insurance.
document.evidence: Proves what Keystone held: 81 pages, Exhibits A–J, emailed to Dana Whitfield 07/20/2026; acknowledged 07/22/2026, so **the window closes 08/21/2026**.
handling: Atty. Thorne **sets every term**; you build and serve it
Serve it by email to Dana Whitfield, **no certified mail**
Docket 30 days **from her written acknowledgement**, never the send
No acknowledgement? **Follow up that day**; escalate to Atty. Thorne

job: Action Plan Editor → UM demand templates
